name: log_health_fact
description: Log a single structured health fact the patient just stated — a surgery, medication, chronic condition, or symptom about themselves. Call this immediately after the patient states a discrete fact, one call per fact, not in a batch at the end of the conversation.

person.description: Always 'self' in this stage — personal history only.

category.description: The type of personal health fact being logged.

approx_age.description: Patient's approximate age at the event, if known. Omit if unknown.

confidence.description: How precise/certain the patient's statement was.
